footer.description: Professional software and firmware development courses. Learn Blockchain, TCP/IP, Computer Vision, ESP32, STM32, Raspberry Pi and FPGA with real projects.

hero.subtitle: Professional courses on Blockchain, TCP/IP, Computer Vision, ESP32, STM32, Raspberry Pi and FPGA. Every line of code is explained.

landing.whySubtitle: We are not just another tutorial. Every course is a living tutorial with compilable code, didactic comments and real progression.
landing.coursesSubtitle: From Linux systems programming to digital design with FPGA. Each course is a complete learning path.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to code at the metal?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join Firmware Academy and master systems development, firmware and embedded applications with real projects.

realCode.title: Real Code, Not Slides
realCode.desc: Every lesson has executable code with comments explaining each decision. No unnecessary abstractions.

fromZero.title: From Zero to Production
fromZero.desc: Incremental progression: first the minimal concept, then variants, and finally the robust version.

understand.title: Understand, Not Copy
understand.desc: We explain the why behind each solution. Trade-offs, alternatives, common mistakes and how to debug them.

systems.title: C/C++ and Systems
systems.desc: Focused on systems programming: syscalls, POSIX, kernel, firmware. What tutorials don't teach you.
